what: PyTorch .pth pickle from the same Hugging Face account; when loaded it runs a shell command that downloads a script from 194.34.254.219:10410 and pipes it to sh. The report's text calls it kpc.pth once; its indicators table says kcp.pth.

evidence.basis: Rapid7 prints this SHA-256 for kcp.pth in the report's indicators of compromise and describes the command the pickle runs when it is deserialized.

source.title: From .pth to p0wned: Abuse of Pickle Files in AI Model Supply Chains
